failure_reason: In leave-one-dataset-out and leakage-free external evaluation on TULIP, the RBF kernel value collapses to ~0 for all test points due to severe 288-dimensional domain shift (mean distance 1930 vs training 16). The decision function reduces to constant intercept b=+0.301, predicting 100% Parkinson's across all participants (sensitivity 100%, specificity 0%). Tree models conversely predict 0% sensitivity (100% Healthy). Therefore, no candidate achieves acceptable out-of-domain generalization without domain-matched training data.
production_decision: Retain models/pd_detector.pkl as production model per Phase 5 Rule 7 to avoid deploying a broken classifier that flags 100% of external videos as Parkinson's.
